description.narrative: The "Programme of evaluation in industry" project (hereinafter referred also as PEVI project) is a follow-up of the #Promotion of Industrial Energy Efficiency in Colombian Industries# project (UNIDO ID 140122) completed in September 2019, which contributed to the transformation of the market for industrial energy efficiency services and products in Colombia focusing on energy management systems (EnMS) # ISO 50001, energy system optimization (ESO), and delivery mechanisms at institutional and business level. The PEVI Project aims to establish three industrial energy assessment centres in three different Colombian universities that will support respective region#s industries with provision of energy assessments/audits, awareness raising and training on EnMS-ESO best-a vailable technologies and advisory services for development of energy efficiency measures. The PEVI Project would: 1. Strengthen the technical capacities of the work teams at the universities and/or research centres that have carried out work and research in the field of energy efficiency and have an active relationship with the industrial sector. 2.
